title: Fix Edit/Delete Record blank screen regression and harden pickup rendering

requirements.summary: Fix the blank screen regression when selecting a pickup in Edit/Delete Record so the edit form always renders without runtime errors.
acceptanceCriteria: From the Edit/Delete Record dialog, clicking any pickup in the list does not result in a blank screen.
After selecting a pickup, the edit form renders with the selected pickup’s data populated.
No uncaught exceptions are thrown in the browser console during record selection and edit-form rendering.

file_operations.description: Fix record-selection transition by making all pickup date/time conversions consistent and safe (convert bigint timestamps to Date using the correct unit, and avoid BigInt(NaN) and Invalid Date paths during selection + form initialization).

Add shared defensive helpers for pickup rendering/editing: safe bigint timestamp -> Date conversion, safe time input string derivation, and safe parsing for time input -> timestamp to prevent crashes during dialog transitions.

requirements.summary: Harden Edit/Delete Record UI rendering against malformed/empty pickup fields (time/date conversions, numeric formatting, nullable fields) so it never crashes and shows safe fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: If a pickup has missing/empty fields (e.g., empty time string, unexpected numeric values), the edit screen still renders and shows safe fallbacks instead of crashing.
Pickup totals displayed in the list and/or edit form never call numeric formatting on undefined/NaN values (no crashes from e.g. toFixed).

file_operations.description: Create numeric formatting helpers (e.g., safeCurrency / safeFixed) that never call toFixed on non-finite values and provide stable UI fallbacks.

Apply defensive rendering and parsing: guard nullable text fields, ensure time parsing handles empty/invalid values, and use safe numeric formatting helpers for any displayed totals to prevent toFixed-related crashes.
Harden pickup list currency rendering by replacing direct toFixed calls on pickup fields with safe formatting helpers so malformed numeric values cannot crash the list.

requirements.summary: Ensure Edit/Delete Record save/delete flows remain reliable end-to-end: after update/delete, return to list; on failure, remain usable and show an English toast error.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing a pickup and clicking Save persists changes (via backend updatePickup) and the dialog returns to the pickup list view.
Deleting a pickup persists deletion (via backend deletePickup) and the dialog returns to the pickup list view.
On backend or network failure, the app remains usable (no blank screen) and shows an English error toast.

file_operations.description: Ensure save/delete handlers always leave the dialog in a usable state: keep list/edit view state transitions deterministic (only return to list on success), and on errors keep the form rendered while surfacing a readable English toast message (no blank screen).
Add a small helper to extract a stable English error message from unknown errors (Error, string, nested objects) to reuse in toasts for update/delete failures.
